decisions.question: D06-Q02, D12-Q01
decisions.rule: The engine redials a persistent (pinned) peer for as long as it runs, instead of giving up after about 24.6 hours. Each backoff wait is at most persistent_peers_max_dial_period, which the production profile requires from 1 s to 1 h.
decisions.supersedes: The 0s approved in approvals/P01_E05_VALUES_4_2026-10-02.json, when the value had no effect.
